comparison.objective: Lower a bent tube into a checking fixture so four legs seat simultaneously in their slots.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual level transport, multi-feature 3-D alignment, gentle simultaneous insertion, and release under self-weight.
comparison.success_condition: All four legs seated within slot tolerances, tube released and stable; excessive drop speed or leaving the bench permanently fails.
comparison.reason: This tests coordinated multi-point fixture seating without force. The candidate instead tests localized impact fracture and post-fracture debris handling; simultaneous geometric alignment alone is only a shared generic primitive.
